newsitem.title: CHINA: Motorola to spend $200 mln on China plant.
newsitem.headline: Motorola to spend $200 mln on China plant.

text.p: U.S. electronics giant Motorola Inc plans to spend more than $200 million to expand a semiconductor joint venture in China's southwestern province of Sichuan, the Xinhua news agency said Thursday.
The investment would fund a third phase of construction of the Leshan-Pheonix Semiconductor Co. in the Sichuan capital of Chengdu, the agency said.
The first and second construction phases at the plant, which was Motorola's first joint venture in China, cost a total of more than $50 million, it said.
About 95 percent of the venture's output was earmarked for export, and Motorola officials planned to build the venture into a semiconductor production centre, it said.

The project's third phase would allow the introduction of a new series of products, including power semiconductor devices and integrated circuits, most of which would also be exported, the agency said. It gave no further details.
